name: 1D spectral blend of global and local features
plain: rfft along dim 1 with a cosine transition, taking lows from one tensor and highs from another. Dim 1 here is a feature or sequence axis inside a patched module, not image space; only the function was read, not how the pack routes it.
math:
mask=1 below cutoff−tw/2, cosine down across cutoff±tw/2, 0 above
F=Fg·mask+Fl(1−mask); out=irfft(F); lerp with local by strength
label: from code

audit.note: Transition is centred on the cutoff, not above it. iamccs_move_ahead.py:111-118: cosine runs over cutoff−tw//2 to cutoff+tw//2, so mask is already below 1 just under the cutoff.
